Customs Duty Estimator

Estimate landed cost: item value times your duty rate plus shipping and fees.

Estimate only — real rates vary by country, product classification, and trade agreements. Confirm with your customs authority. For information only — not financial advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the item (customs) value.
  2. Enter the duty rate % that applies.
  3. Add shipping, insurance, and any other fees.
  4. Read the duty owed, total landed cost, and effective rate.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where do I find the real duty rate?

From your country's customs tariff schedule, usually by HS product code. This tool cannot know your product's classification.

Is duty charged on shipping too?

It depends on the country. Many charge duty on the CIF value (goods + insurance + freight). Enter the value basis your customs uses.

Why is this only an estimate?

Rates vary by country, product, trade agreements, and de minimis thresholds. Always confirm with your customs authority or broker.
